_comment: Configuration registry for the forge2 artifact_tree_gen package. Every registry-gated tool in this package walks UP the tree from its OWN file to find this file, and throws if it cannot see it (see the congruency repo's note-for-claude: 'if a tool cannot see the registry it will throw an exeption'). It sits beside the modules it configures, so they resolve their config from a clean checkout with no setup. Each unit reads only its own section; a unit whose section is absent throws, which is the gate working rather than a defect. This registry was filed by ticket #405, which covers the fib unit only, so fib is the only section here.

fib._comment: Config object for forge2:artifact_tree_gen/fib (module key forge-rw:f3df615229b4c9f7, ticket #405). 'trace' is the telemetry decorator the ORIGINAL unit hardcoded as `from code_pipeline import trace`; naming it here instead is #200's control-config requirement. null runs fib undecorated; a "module:attr" string (for example "code_pipeline:trace") applies that hook. A trace hook is telemetry and returns the wrapped result unchanged, so it does not alter what fib returns. It is null here because code_pipeline is not importable in this checkout.
